detections.evidence_quote: I fucked up my back. I woke up on Wednesday morning and couldn't really stand up.
detections.summary: Host describes hurting his lower back, being unable to stand, lying on the floor, shooting pain down his leg, and a suspected bulging disc.

detections.evidence_quote: every doctor is busy shooting people up with 5G
detections.summary: Joking line that he cannot see a doctor because doctors are busy 'shooting people up with 5G', alluding to the vaccine-5G trope.

detections.evidence_quote: I've been taking muscle relaxers at night.
detections.summary: Host says he has been taking muscle relaxants at night for the back pain.

detections.evidence_quote: you have to actually exercise, and do things with your body to make your body not hurt anymore
detections.summary: Hosts say recovering from the back injury and preventing recurrence requires constant stretching and exercise rather than a pill or patch.

detections.evidence_quote: You got to do abs.
detections.summary: Co-host adds that ab work is needed to protect the back in future.

detections.evidence_quote: I had Billy walking on my back like he was Lucy Liu.
detections.summary: Host had a friend walk on his back as massage; co-host warns against having someone walk on an injured back.

detections.evidence_quote: Just rubbing CBD on my spine.
detections.summary: Host mentions rubbing CBD on his spine for the back pain.

detections.evidence_quote: No, the disc, a bulging disc, like basically hits the nerve.
detections.summary: Hosts debate whether it is muscular or a disc problem; a bulging disc is said to hit the sciatic nerve, need stretches, and linger for life.

detections.evidence_quote: Some HGH.
detections.summary: Host asks why he can't just take drugs, and growth hormone (HGH) for his back is jokingly raised.

detections.evidence_quote: Billy convinced me I had COVID on Sunday.
detections.summary: Co-host recounts being convinced he had COVID after vomiting and forgetfulness, checking his temperature all week, and being told muscle and back aches are COVID signs.

detections.evidence_quote: I had I had food poisoning, and I told them I had food poisoning.
detections.summary: Co-host says he actually had food poisoning from Chinese food, vomiting twice, though others who ate it did not get sick.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Muscle aches and back aches are probably a sign of COVID.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Billy also said muscle aches and back aches are probably a sign of COVID.
verification_candidates.rationale: A stated symptom-to-diagnosis link for COVID that could shape how listeners interpret aches.

verification_candidates.claim_text: A bulging disc causes pain by pressing on the nerve.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: a bulging disc, like basically hits the nerve
verification_candidates.rationale: A mechanistic explanation of disc-related nerve pain that can be checked against clinical knowledge.

verification_candidates.claim_text: A bulging disc slowly subsides with stretching but stays with the person for the rest of their life.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: It will slowly go down, and then it will be with you for the rest.
verification_candidates.rationale: A prognosis claim about disc injuries that could shape expectations and treatment choices.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Recovering from a back injury and keeping it from recurring requires doing a lot of stretching and exercise rather than taking a pill.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: It seems that, in order to make yourself feel better and have this not happen again, you have to do a lot of work.
verification_candidates.rationale: A treatment and prevention claim about back pain management that evidence could support or contradict.
